description: Equity, free margin, used margin and open profit or loss on every exchange account the user connected (Hyperliquid, Bybit, Binance, OKX, sandbox), and the total. Use to report balances or to compare free margin across exchanges. Not needed before opening: size_position reads equity itself. Not for positions (use get_my_positions). No inputs. Amounts in USD (USDC / USDT count as USD). Next: get_my_positions.
name: get_my_balances

available_margin.description: Margin free for new positions, USD

book.description: sandbox (play money) or real (an exchange account, demo or live)

currency.description: The venue's settlement stablecoin (USDC or USDT), counted as USD

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

equity.description: Account equity, USD: the settlement stablecoin only (its balance plus open profit or loss), which margins the perpetuals; risk limits are shares of this

other_assets_usd.description: Other coins in the same exchange account (e.g. a demo account's gifted BTC), USD; shown only, never counted as equity or by any limit

used_margin.description: Margin held by open positions, USD

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

total_equity.description: Sum of equity on every connected venue, USD (play money and exchange accounts together; see total_equity_by_book)

total_equity_by_book.description: Equity per book, USD: sandbox (the built-in play money) and real (exchange accounts, demo or live); risk limits count each book apart
